g.text: Student single reservation - D1 physical relationships
student_session_access_v1 is the shared guard view (02 section 8).
Provider flows / contacts / binding are defined separately in 02 section 9.
They compose consume and issuance; this diagram shows the reservation FK slice.
Request and atomic Write recheck current session / access / lifecycle.
Suspension / deletion revoke all Student sessions in the same batch.
Clearing suspension never clears revoked_at. No raw token stored.
Actor / target IDs reference a polymorphic audit subject.
Confirm inserts one success row in the same batch.
after_json includes the new reservation and all derived_changes.
Each change records reservation_id and before / after classifications.
updated_by is the resolved Admin Actor ID, without a speculative FK.
